mapper.select: SELECT record_id, member_id, fingerprint, fingerprint_member_id, document, photo, media_type, status, created_at, expires_at FROM dietary_record WHERE record_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dietary_record (record_id, member_id, fingerprint, fingerprint_member_id, document, photo, media_type, status, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{memberId}, #{fingerprint}, #{fingerprintMemberId}, #{document}, #{photo,jdbcType=LONGVARBINARY}, #{mediaType}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE dietary_record SET document = #{document}, status = #{status}, expires_at = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
UPDATE dietary_record SET photo = NULL WHERE record_id = #{id}
